subject: Re: On‑prem maintenance cadence, version pin windows, and quick‑rewind procedure
content:
From: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@acmehealth.com>
To: rishi.malhotra@redwood.com
Cc: ops@acmehealth.com
Date: Wed, 18 Jun 2025 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: On‑prem maintenance cadence and pinning — scheduling ask

Hi Rishi,

Thanks again for the walkthrough yesterday. We need to lock down a recurring maintenance cadence for our on‑prem/private deployment (VPC + on‑prem edge). A few constraints from our side:

- We require a 4‑hour narrow window (local overnight) for any non‑security upgrades.
- Emergency security fixes can be applied outside the window but we need a documented fast‑rewind path if the change causes regressions.
- We prefer version pinning for the model/runtime bundle during business hours and allow rolling pin updates during the maintenance window only.

Can you share a proposed cadence (weekly/biweekly), the rollback/rewind steps, and who we should escalate to if the canary fails? Also please include the artifact naming we should pin against (model_vX/Y, runtime package).

Appreciate it — Samantha

--
Samantha Lee
Head of Cloud Ops, AcmeHealth
